item: currentValue of an orbit-held param (05 "(measure) captures" 2)
case: two short notes per bar into the orbit delay (dry 0), delaytime <.02 .03 .03>, an lfo on delaytime with depth 0.5 * currentValue; bar 1's first hap schedules setValueAtTime(0.03, t) before its second hap reads currentValue at the same pause

candidates.description: Param::value(): the intrinsic value the last rendered quantum left (the timeline's last frame, before inputs): bar 1's haps read 0.02, bar 2's 0.03
the timeline value at the pause frame: identical to (a) here (no delayTime event lies on a pause frame: the harness schedules a bar's haps 0.05 s before the bar), so not separable by this case
not a rule of the table, a control: the value of the param's last scheduled event (bar 1's second hap would read 0.03)

outcome: outcome (a): Param::value() is kept; no Param::value_at is added. The case is redesigned from 05's sketch (dep 0.5 instead of da 0.01, and a delaytime pattern) so that currentValue reaches the audio. A first design with fxr(0.2), meant to keep the voice alive past its sound for the modulator, rendered differently between Chromium runs (worklet-determinism: firstDiffFrame 31616, worst -51.77 dB): the lfo then ends together with the chain's main-thread releaseNodes; it was dropped and the keep-alive clause is pinned by the modulate.rs unit test orbit_held_modulators_keep_the_voice_alive
method: the control candidate was measured by patching voice.rs's orbit-delay currentValue in a scratch build and running micro.rs against the committed ref; the patch is not committed
